subject: Finora MAP draft — reforecast and milestone reprioritization
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@finora.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finora.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Finora: MAP draft and next steps (post-discovery)

Hi Ben + Olivia — great to meet today. Quick recap and the MAP draft attached (Finora_MAP_v1.xlsx).

Summary from today
- Goal: evaluate Redwood to power Finora’s clinical note generation and embedding search for triage. Primary success metric: 80% accuracy on test prompts and <120ms median token latency for 99th percentile traffic profile.
- Risks: procurement timeline, SOC2 evidence, and integration with your data workspace (S3 buckets + VPC).

Proposed MAP (high level) — target close: 2026-06-30
1) POC kickoff — owner: Finora (Olivia) / Redwood (Karthik) — target: 2026-05-07
2) Security questionnaire + infra checklist — owner: Finora Sec / Redwood Sec (Vivek) — target: 2026-05-21
3) Technical POC results & performance validation — owner: Finora Eng / Redwood SE — target: 2026-06-11
4) Commercial review & SOW finalization — owner: Finora Procurement / Redwood AE — target: 2026-06-25

Dependencies: access to a redacted dataset for the POC, SOC2 evidence (we can share), and a named procurement contact.

Ask: please review the MAP draft and call out any changes to owners or dates by end of day Tuesday (2026-04-21). I attached an editable MAP (Finora_MAP_v1.xlsx). If these milestones look good, I’ll version it with dates locked.

Attachments: Finora_MAP_v1.xlsx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

From: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@finora.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finora.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-19T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finora: MAP draft and next steps (post-discovery)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick update from procurement/proj mgmt: there’s been a push internally to sequence security & procurement approvals earlier, and our procurement cycle for vendor onboarding has slipped. We’re expecting a new internal approval milestone that won’t clear until late July.

Implication: we can still start a scoped POC early (May) but the official commercial close will likely be pushed. Realistic reforecast: target close moves to 2026-09-15. Key suggestion: reprioritize the MAP so the security questionnaire and vendor onboarding are front-loaded and the wider commercial negotiation sits after proof-of-value.

I’m attaching a short procurement timeline we use internally (Procurement_timeline_vFinora.pdf). Can you produce an updated MAP reflecting a Sep 15 close and the reprioritized milestones? If you can show a plan that gets security evidence and onboarding checklist done by end of Jun, we’ll try to accelerate procurement sign-off.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Wallace
Director, Platform Operations | Finora
ben.wallace@finora.com | +1 646 555 0122

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@finora.com>, Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@finora.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-04-20T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Finora: MAP draft and next steps (post-discovery)

Thanks for the update, Ben — really helpful. I’ve reworked the MAP and attached Finora_MAP_v2.xlsx and a light SOW draft (Finora_SOW_draft.pdf) that reflects the scoped POC + commercial timeline. Key changes below (high level):

Reforecasted target close: 2026-09-15
Reprioritized milestones (owner / target)
- Security evidence & onboarding checklist — owner: Redwood Sec (Vivek) + Finora Sec (Olivia) — target: 2026-06-25 (front-loaded)
- Scoped POC (redacted data) — owner: Finora Eng / Redwood SE (Karthik) — target: 2026-06-11 (confirm infra access by May 7)
- Performance validation & eval results — owner: Finora Eng / Redwood SE — target: 2026-07-23
- Commercial negotiation & SOW signed — owner: Finora Procurement / Redwood AE — target: 2026-09-08

Dependencies and mitigation
- Procurement ramp: we propose weekly 15-min syncs with your procurement lead starting May 4 to unblock paperwork earlier.
- SOC2 / evidence: Vivek will share our SOC2 artifact list and a template evidence bundle by 2026-04-24 to accelerate your internal review.
- Data access: please confirm a read-only S3 path for the redacted dataset by 2026-05-07.

Next steps I propose
1) Review MAP v2 and confirm owners/dates by Fri 2026-04-23.
2) If confirmed, we’ll lock MAP v2 and set a recurring weekly procurement sync (calendar invite from me).
3) Karthik and I will schedule a 60-min POC planning call with Finora Eng to scope test cases (suggest week of Apr 27).

Quoted for context:
> On Apr 19, 2026, Ben Wallace <ben.wallace@finora.com> wrote:
> Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Quick update from procurement/proj mgmt: there’s been a push internally to sequence security & procurement approvals earlier...

Attachments: Finora_MAP_v2.xlsx; Finora_SOW_draft.pdf

Let me know if you want me to convert MAP v2 to a shared Drive sheet for live edits.

Best,
Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198

Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the updated MAP. I reviewed v2 and the milestones look reasonable given our constraints. Confirming Finora is aligned with the Sep 15 reforecast (internal approvals expected by end of July).

A couple quick asks:
- Please share MAP v2 in a Drive sheet and we’ll add our procurement contact (name TBD).
- Can you send a short calendar invite for a 30-min sync the week of Apr 27 to walk through the POC scope and data access steps? We’ll invite the security owner once identified.

If you can get MAP v2 into Drive today that would be ideal.
